location.verification_method: Static read of SymfonyRuntime.php at v5.4.45 and the three fixed tags, the fix commit and its phpt regression tests, plus peeled-tag ancestry checks; no PHP runtime or web server was executed.

entry_point.description: Runtime bootstrap constructed by the front controller. On a web SAPI with register_argc_argv=On, PHP populates $_SERVER['argv'] from the query string, so the constructor's argv branch processes attacker-controlled values.

critical_operation.description: In 5.4.45 the constructor treats the presence of $_SERVER['argv'] as proof of a CLI SAPI. It calls getInput(), which builds ArgvInput and applies --env/-e and --no-debug to putenv/$_SERVER/$_ENV without checking the SAPI or $_GET. When register_argc_argv=On on a web SAPI, a crafted query string becomes argv, so an unauthenticated request can switch APP_ENV (for example to dev) or set APP_DEBUG. The fix requires $_GET to be empty at the call site and makes getInput throw when $_GET is non-empty and register_argc_argv is on.

trace.description: argv presence alone selects the console-input path
getInput constructs ArgvInput from the query-derived argv without a SAPI/register_argc_argv check
--env/-e and --no-debug are written into $_SERVER/$_ENV via putenv, changing kernel environment and debug mode

source_crosscheck.notes: All families agree on the fixed releases (5.4.46, 6.4.14, 7.1.7) and on the two-guard source fix. They disagree on the alias, severity representation, CWE set and lower bound: the correct GHSA is GHSA-x8vp-gf4q-mw5j; the CNA/NVD CVSS v3.1 is 7.3 HIGH while the GHSA page's primary CVSS v4.0 is 6.9 MODERATE; the CNA/NVD list only CWE-74 while GHSA/OSV add CWE-20; the CNA writes '<5.4.46' while GHSA/OSV/FriendsOfPHP write '>=5.3.0'. NVD carried no Primary metric and marked the record Deferred. OSV's GIT endpoints are release commits with the source fix appended as REFERENCES_COMMIT. The canonical fields use the CNA vector, CWE-74, and the >=5.3.0 lower bound.

limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.

No PHP runtime, web server or HTTP request was executed. The claim that register_argc_argv=On populates $_SERVER['argv'] from the query string is taken from the advisory and the upstream phpt test, which emulates that behavior explicitly.
The phpt regression test was read, not run; it asserts env=dev survives an argv of [' ', '-e', 'test'] when $_GET is non-empty.
The fix only guards the non-CLI path when $_GET is non-empty; the advisory's wording ('ignores argv for non-CLI SAPIs') is broader than the code, which relies on $_GET as the web-request signal.

The vulnerable snapshot is v5.4.45; the same snapshot is also the evaluation target for CVE-2024-50345, which is legitimate because both vulnerabilities exist at the same exact SHA. The 6.4 and 7.1 branches were checked only for fix ancestry and fixed-file content.
The repository snapshot has 11040 tracked files and 150 ambiguous files; the language job is NEEDS_REVIEW, not a clean PASS.
No dynamic red/green test was run, so no reproduction_reference exists and the entry is grade B at best.

The correct GitHub advisory alias is GHSA-x8vp-gf4q-mw5j. GHSA-qq5c-677p-737q, initially assumed from an adjacent candidate row, belongs to CVE-2024-51736 (symfony/process cmd.exe hijack); the independent reviewer caught the mix-up and the dossier now uses the alias confirmed by the CVE record references, OSV, GitHub HTML and the advisory-database.

NVD has no nvd@nist.gov CVSS metric for this CVE: its only cvssMetricV31 entry is Secondary (source security-advisories@github.com), weaknesses are also Secondary, configurations are null and vulnStatus is Deferred. The canonical 7.3 HIGH therefore comes from the CNA/GHSA record, not from an NVD analysis.

Severity representations disagree across sources: the CNA/NVD v3.1 vector is 7.3 HIGH, while the GHSA page's primary CVSS v4.0 vector is 6.9 MODERATE (CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:L/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N).
CWE sets disagree: the CNA and NVD list only CWE-74; the GHSA/OSV record adds CWE-20. The canonical cwe_ids keeps CWE-74.

The affected lower bound disagrees: the CNA writes '< 5.4.46' literally, while GHSA/OSV/FriendsOfPHP write '>= 5.3.0' because symfony/runtime was introduced in 5.3. The canonical 5.4 range is '>=5.3,<5.4.46'.

OSV's GIT fixed endpoints are the release commits 057d88be, d1797e5b and 50011435; the source fix a77b308c appears only as a trailing fixed event tagged REFERENCES_COMMIT. The release commits are not used as the fix commit.
The CVE description contains two drafting errors: it writes 'register_argv_argc' instead of 'register_argc_argv' and 'non-SAPI PHP runtimes' instead of non-CLI SAPIs.

The GitHub REST API was rate-limited from the shared egress IP, so the repository numeric id 458058 was not re-checked through the API by the reviewer; it is taken from the existing catalog and is not part of the promoted vulnerability fields.
open_questions: Which production deployments actually run with register_argc_argv=On was not measured; the vulnerability is conditional on that directive.

Whether the injected APP_ENV can be escalated beyond information disclosure in a specific application (for example dev toolbar, profiler, or debug error pages) is application-specific and outside this snapshot.
